title: Test Subject #C{Count}

moves.title: Respawn
effects: Apply Painful Stabs (1st respawn) or Nemesis (2nd respawn)

move_pattern: Phase 1: Alternates Bite and Skull Bash. On first defeat: Respawns with 212 HP and Painful Stabs, enters Phase 2. Phase 2: Repeatedly uses Multi-Claw with hit count increasing each turn (3, 4, 5, ...). On second defeat: Respawns with 313 HP and Nemesis, enters Phase 3. Phase 3: Cycles Lacerate → Big Pounce → Burning Growl.
notes: Multi-phase monster with respawning mechanics through Adaptable power. Form 1: 111 HP. Form 2: 212 HP after first respawn (gains Painful Stabs power). Form 3: 313 HP after second respawn (gains Nemesis power, loses Adaptable and Painful Stabs). Multi-Claw attack escalates in power during Phase 2, increasing hit count by 1 each turn (3→4→5→...). Monster title includes a counter that increments with each defeat (Test Subject Kill Count + 8). After 2 respawns, cannot revive further and disappears from Doom mechanics.
